description: This file defines the ConnectionManager class, responsible for managing network connections, security parameters, and device capabilities within an Android application. It includes methods for resolving TLS parameters, constructing connection options, and generating user-agent strings.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: Manages network connection settings, TLS parameters, and device capabilities for the Android app, providing methods to construct connection and capability options, and generate user agent strings.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint
methods.description: Determines the appropriate TLS parameters for a given gateway endpoint based on stored fingerprints, endpoint hints, and configuration flags.

methods.name: runtimeFlags
methods.description: Gathers runtime device and app capabilities into a NodeRuntimeFlags object.

methods.name: buildInvokeCommands
methods.description: Returns a list of commands to be advertised for invocation, based on runtime flags.

methods.name: buildCapabilities
methods.description: Returns a list of capabilities to be advertised based on runtime flags.

methods.name: resolvedVersionName
methods.description: Returns the app version name, appending '-dev' if in debug mode.

methods.name: resolveModelIdentifier
methods.description: Constructs a device model identifier string from manufacturer and model data.

methods.name: buildUserAgent
methods.description: Creates a user-agent string for the app based on version and device info.

methods.name: buildClientInfo
methods.description: Builds a GatewayClientInfo object with app and device metadata.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions
methods.description: Constructs connection options for a node role in the gateway.

methods.name: buildOperatorConnectOptions
methods.description: Constructs connection options for an operator role in the gateway.

methods.name: resolveTlsParams
methods.description: Retrieves stored TLS fingerprint and resolves comprehensive TLS parameters for a given gateway endpoint.
